back: An organisation that protects and promotes consumers' interests: education, complaints, monitoring and influencing laws.

front: Five roles of a national consumer council?
back: Educating consumers, handling complaints, price and quality monitoring, research and testing, representing consumers, lobbying, warning the public (any five).

front: Roles of the Standards Association of Zimbabwe?
back: Develops standards, tests products, certifies them with a standards mark, certifies management systems, trains businesses.
An agreed set of requirements a product, service or process must meet (safety, quality, size, composition).

front: What does a standards mark tell consumers?
back: The product has been tested and meets a published standard.
Local authority inspectors, regulators and ministries, police and courts, trade associations, the media.

front: First step when goods are faulty?
back: Return to the seller with the goods and receipt; go to a protection body only if the seller refuses.
Low awareness, urban offices, limited funds and staff, limited enforcement power, informal traders hard to trace.
